verdicts.strongest_argument: The commercial event this claim points to - Asana quantifying AI Studio / AI product contribution on THIS call - is not novel: on the Q1 FY27 call (2026-05-28) management explicitly said it 'plans to provide a more comprehensive update on AI product contribution during its second-quarter call,' and already disclosed AI product bookings at 17% of net-new ARR vs a 15% FY target. That pre-commitment is in every transcript recap, so the market is already positioned for an AI number this print. The specific evidence the hunter adds - an API enum (ai_studio_plus/pro/max, credit_source paid/free) - is plumbing, not revenue: an enum value proves a tier can be represented in the data model, not that 'Max' is sold, priced, or contributing material ARR. 'Max appears nowhere on the pricing page' is equally consistent with an unlaunched or internal tier as with a stealth premium SKU. So the narrative is priced and the incremental enum evidence does not establish the commercial magnitude being inferred.

verdicts.strongest_argument: The 8-K handing the PAO role to CFO Megji is public (filed 2026-08-28, event 2026-08-26) and was covered by stocktitan, and every earlier leg - Sosa's March appointment, her July resignation, the Parekh-to-Megji CFO transition - was individually disclosed and reported. Crucially the filings state there were no disagreements and no issues with accounting policies or practices, which deflates the governance-risk inference the claim draws. The market's own reaction is dispositive here: rather than sell on the 08-26 news, ASAN rose ~8.9% on 08-29 into the print, so the tape treated the finance-leadership churn as immaterial. Governance turnover of this kind rarely reaches an earnings-print move absent a restatement, which no source alleges.
